question: Should failed duplicate-ingress results expose the full original payload to all queue consumers, or should payload recovery be restricted to a dedicated trusted diagnostic/recovery surface?
rationale: This is an intentional data-access and retention-boundary choice; the patch is mechanically small, but source-level review must confirm which callers are allowed to receive unprocessed inbound content.

options.title: Restrict payload recovery
options.body: Expose raw payload only through a narrowly trusted diagnostic or recovery API and keep general failed duplicate records metadata-only.

options.title: Accept generic payload exposure
options.body: Keep the additive field after documenting the trusted-consumer contract and verifying that all current consumers handle sensitive payloads safely.

recommendation.title: Restrict payload recovery
recommendation.body: Expose raw payload only through a narrowly trusted diagnostic or recovery API and keep general failed duplicate records metadata-only.

likelyOwner.reason: Adjacent ingress-recovery history is the only available concrete routing signal in the supplied context.
